Energy and Action Cost

A Medabot's actions require an action cost.

You start with 10 Energy and gain 1 each turn, up to a maximum of 16.
Energy is fully restored at the start of your turn.
About Power

If your power is higher than the enemy's,
you make it cease to function.

If both powers are equal, both cease to function!
About Barriers

A Barrier is a special device that guards the Leader Medabot.
While one remains, the Leader cannot cease to function.
Destroying a Barrier grants Energy, so you can act more.
Barriers normally start at 6, which is also the maximum.
About Overheat

An overheated Medabot cannot act until it cools down.

It also cannot counterattack while overheated.
So even at equal power, only it ceases to function.
